snippet.title: Zlin City: Diorama | REVEAL | EN
snippet.description:
https://www.zlincity.com/alpha

Build charming miniature diorama cities and train routes in a magical world inspired by the 1920s–30s. Create cozy towns, craft detailed rail networks, and relax to an original soundtrack. Inspired by real historical events and the architecture of Zlin.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017770/Zlin_City_Diorama/
Web: https://www.zlincity.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/ZlinCity
Discord: https://tinyurl.com/zlincity

Socials

X: https://x.com/zlincity

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/zlincitygame/

Scénář a voiceover: Pavel Novák
Video: David Malý
